entries.content: PPC record for Brightside Fixtures. Target CPA on Google search: $80.00 (8000 cents), set by the owner 2026-06-15. Monthly spend cap: $4,000.00 (400000 cents) across Google. Protected: the Brand - Brightside campaign (cmp_102) and any query containing 'brightside' - no negative, pause, bid, or budget change on brand without the owner's written sign-off. Approval cadence: negatives as one reviewed list per confirmation; every budget or bidding change is one confirmation each. Negatives ledger: 2026-08-12 'jobs' (phrase, cmp_101) added by the partner agency.
